title: Godot testing for iOS on Windows
author: anatawaurusai2
selftext:
Hi, 

  
I am building a game using godot. As part of the developement, I have created some tests that can open 2 godot desktop instances, the 1st can host a lobby, the 2nd can join the lobby, and then they are both given the seed for the scene and can see each others movements and it works pretty well. The fact that the tests can automatically verify a lot of the multiplayer basics is very helpful. 

Lately, as the game expands and more bugs are being fixed, I am noticing that although godot desktop tests pass, I am seeing issues on ipad. I generally push the code to github which can then generate the ipa that I load onto the ipad with sideloadly. In the last bug, I put the exact same code (I have the version number and commit number on the home screen) on 2 ipads and one worked but the other couldn't even create a lobby. 



I am interested in the idea of testing the ipad build with unit tests. I am on windows. I see XCode debugging for USB connected devices and I see xogot-connect for wifi devices, but I am not sure I can run that from windows...   


I am curious if there is a best practice here that doesn't involve buying a mac that could automate some of the ipad testing. Thank you for any advice!
